bays.road: Bath Road, Hounslow (outside 270 to 276 and 292 to 300)
bays.restriction: On-street parking bays — 30 minutes free ('park and shop'): outside 270 to 276 and 292 to 300
bays.times: First 30 minutes free — a PayByPhone or PayPoint session must still be started. Charging hours and maximum stay are as signed on the bay
bays.tariff: Emissions-based PayByPhone charges, per hour (priced in 30-minute steps; the council's table runs to 5 hours): Band 1 £1.60; Band 2 £2.40; Band 3 £3.20; Band 4 £3.40; Band 5 £3.60; Band 6 £3.80; Band 7 £4.00. Diesel surcharge 40p per hour. Bands: Band 1 (0 g/km), Band 2 (1–75), Band 3 (76–100), Band 4 (101–130), Band 5 (131–170), Band 6 (171–225), Band 7 (226+)
bays.pay: PayByPhone (app, web or phone) or cash at a PayPoint shop; contactless terminals at some sites
